mapper.select: SELECT SUM(orders.out_count - orders.return_count) FROM erp_sale_order orders WHERE orders.status = 20 AND orders.order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND orders.tenant_id = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.framework.tenant.core.context.TenantContextHolder@getRequiredTenantId()} AND orders.deleted = 0

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_sale_order WHERE order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) AS sale_order_total_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_sale_order WHERE status = 10 AND order_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) AS no_approval_sale_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_sale_out WHERE out_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) AS sale_out_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_sale_return WHERE return_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) AS sale_return_order_count
